params.prompt:
The exact same character shown in the reference images: Lume, an original stylized 3D animated mascot, a small furry creature (image 1 is the original design, image 2 is the approved straight-on front view of the same character, image 3 is the approved rear three-quarter view from his other side, which defines his rear design, fur and rendering style). Keep his design exactly: soft golden-peach fur; lighter cream muzzle, chest and belly; large round ears with pink interiors; large round blue eyes with big black pupils, white highlights and small lashes at the outer corners; dark expressive eyebrows; glossy pink-red nose; rosy pink cheeks; long thin dark whiskers; a brown swept-up hair tuft on top of the head; two small upper front teeth; a large head on a compact rounded body with a round belly, short limbs and rounded paws with the same stubby fingers and toes as the references; a fluffy golden-peach tail with a purple tip. Same 3D animated-film rendering style, same colours, same soft detailed fur texture, same head-to-body proportions as the references. Friendly happy expression with the same open smile showing the two small front teeth.

VIEW: rear three-quarter view. He stands with his back to the camera, turned 45 degrees so that he faces away toward the far RIGHT of the image. The camera sees his back and his own right side from behind: the back of his head, the back of both ears, a sliver of his right cheek with whiskers, his right arm. His face is mostly hidden. Rear design: his back, the back of his head and the backs of his ears are covered in the same plain golden-peach fur (the cream colour is only on the muzzle, chest and belly; the pink is only inside the ears, on the front). The brown hair tuft is seen from behind on top of the head. The turn must be clear: exactly halfway between a straight back view and a right side profile, so the tip of his pink-red nose, the edge of his right eye and his right rosy cheek are just visible past the edge of his head on the RIGHT side of the image. This view is the opposite side of image 3. Tail in this view: growing from the centre of his lower back and sweeping toward his own left side, which is the far side, so the tail points toward the LEFT side of the image and away from the camera.

Tail anatomy, identical in every view: one tail, attached at the base of his spine at the centre of his lower back, sweeping out toward his own LEFT side and curling slightly upward, golden-peach with a purple tip. Do not move the tail to another place on the body.

FULL BODY at the same scale as reference image 2: he stands upright in a relaxed neutral stance, arms relaxed and held slightly away from his body with the paws lowered beside his hips, feet flat on the floor. The whole character is inside the frame with a margin of empty background on every side: ears, hair tuft, whiskers, paws, feet and any visible part of the tail.

Warm ivory seamless studio background, soft even studio lighting, soft contact shadow under the feet. Camera level at the height of his chest, no wide-angle distortion. Bare base design: no hat, no clothing, no book, no accessories. No props, no text, no logos, no watermark. Do not add new markings, stripes or spots. Do not change him into a different animal.
